messages.game.title: Gem Keep
messages.game.subtitle: Raiders come to steal the gems from your vault and carry them back through their portals. Build towers along the road. A fallen raider drops its gems, and the next one can pick them up.
messages.menu.locked: Win the previous level to unlock
messages.difficulty.label: Difficulty
messages.difficulty.easy.about: Ordinary raiders and full starting gold
messages.difficulty.normal.about: Tougher, faster raiders, less starting gold and smaller bounties
messages.difficulty.hard.about: Twice as tough and much faster raiders, little gold: every tower counts
messages.hud.gems: Gems on the vault plate. Red: gems the raiders are carrying or dropped on the road
messages.hint.controls: Wheel: zoom · Drag: rotate · Right-drag, Shift+drag or pen button: pan · WASD/QE: move
messages.hint.meteor: Click the ground to drop the meteor. Right-click or Esc to cancel.
messages.tower.bolt.about: Fast shots at a single target. Hits flying enemies.
messages.tower.mortar.about: Slow, heavy shells that hurt everything where they land. Cannot hit flying enemies.
messages.tower.frost.about: Light damage that slows enemies down.
messages.tower.storm.about: Lightning that jumps between nearby enemies.
messages.result.lostText: The raiders carried every gem through their portals. Try another tower layout.
